overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused professional social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. Content centers on academic research, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases (CooRnet), and academic recruitment. Engagement is consistently high across all platforms, driven by major announcements such as publications, grant awards, and job openings.

contentThemes.description: Sharing newly published papers, research grants, and studies on coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Updates on analytical software releases like CooRnet v2.0 and discussions on computational social science methods.
Hiring postdocs and inviting PhD applications for research in computational methods and social media analysis.

recommendations: Cross-promote major research breakthroughs simultaneously across all platforms to maximize total reach and viral resharing.
Increase visual content and direct links (e.g., paper PDFs, application forms, project repositories) to drive external conversion and traffic.
Leverage Bluesky's strong virality (high repost-to-like ratio) for crowd-sourcing academic queries and opportunity calls.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest overall engagement rate (~6.14%), with exceptionally high repost rates on academic calls and publication announcements.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche, highly focused audience on aoir.social that engages strongly with open-source tool updates like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base (1,850) with the highest absolute numbers for likes and comments, performing exceptionally well for institutional news and hiring.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
